title: Add makefile targets for running tournament games
description:
Add `make tournament-game` (and possibly `make tournament-games GAMES=N`) for running individual matches in the current end-of-season tournament.

Requirements:
- Read the current tournament from data/season.json -> data/tournaments/season-N.json
- Determine the next match to play based on the bracket (single elimination; seedings determine matchups: 1v8, 2v7, 3v6, 4v5 for an 8-player bracket, etc.)
- Create a game config on the fly using the locked-in preset, personality, and effort for each player
- Run the game using the orchestrator (similar to `make run` but with a tournament-specific config)
- After the game completes, update the tournament JSON with the result (winner advances)
- The format of each tournament game should be determined by the season's tournament config (e.g., all Standard, or best-of-3 across formats)

The tournament file already has `entrants` with locked preset/personality/effort and an empty `rounds` array to fill in. The format field is currently 'single-elimination'.
